signal: Monograph raised a Series B and is scaling its project management platform across architecture, landscape, and interior firms to roughly 120 employees

email.body1:
Katie, saw Monograph scaling the platform post Series B across architecture and design firms.

Growth like that usually exposes signal-to-action latency: in-market firms surface faster than the team can act on them, and data hygiene around handoffs slips. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep, every email auto-logged to your CRM.

I built a signal play for Monograph off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Katie, quick follow-up for Monograph.

From a sales ops seat, the lift usually hides in how fast signals turn into a sent, personalized touch, and in the data quality behind it. Small process changes there compound across every target firm.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of your current outbound and three things I would change. Our best practices alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Katie, last bit of proof for Monograph.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Monograph's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

Katie, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting signal-to-action latency without adding headcount is not a priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know sales ops roadmaps fill up fast and timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your stack? I will tailor it to Monograph either way.
